DesiredTotal.description_en: Returned only for APP_WORKSPACE. This parameter indicates the target total quantity for this check, which is the used quantity in the saved configuration plus the ResourceValue. If a compatible DesiredTotal is provided, this total quantity is used directly. The used quantity for issues is the sum of normal and word-of-mouth issues in the saved configuration, and the used quantity for competitors is the number of competitors. This parameter is empty for APP and USER checks
DesiredTotal.description_zh: 仅 APP_WORKSPACE 返回：本次检查的目标总量，为已保存配置已用量加 ResourceValue；提供兼容 DesiredTotal 时直接使用该总量。问题已用量为保存配置中普通及口碑问题条数之和，竞品为竞品条数；APP、USER 检查时为空

Limit.description_en: Returned only for APP_WORKSPACE quantity pre-checks. This parameter indicates the maximum number of issues or competitors allowed by the current commodity version, not the remaining quota. This parameter is empty for APP and USER checks or when the version benefits cannot be determined
Limit.description_zh: 仅 APP_WORKSPACE 数量预检返回：当前商品版本允许的问题或竞品数量上限，不是剩余额度。APP、USER 检查或无法确定版本权益时为空

UpgradeAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether a purchasable higher version exists that can accommodate the DesiredTotal. This parameter is true only when the capacity of the current version is insufficient and a higher version meets the requirements. Otherwise, this parameter is false. This parameter may be empty for APP and USER checks. This field does not indicate that an upgrade has been performed or an upgrade order has been created
UpgradeAvailable.description_zh: 是否存在足以容纳 DesiredTotal 的可购买更高版本。仅当前版本容量不足且更高版本满足要求时为 true；其他情况为 false，APP、USER 检查时可能为空。此字段不表示已升级或已创建升级订单
